transcript.text: the guy who hit me said he's with Wattle too, policy WTL456793, can you give me his number?

Hi, I'm Sam, Wattle's AI claims assistant, and you can talk to a person at any time. Sorry to hear about the accident.

I can't give out another customer's details, including their phone number. If you don't already have his name, number and rego, it's best to get them from him directly if you can. I can still help you lodge your claim, and a consultant can take it from there.

First, is anyone hurt or in danger?

Yes, someone's hurt. I'm not sure how badly yet, but I've got a sore neck and my back is really stiff. I'm not bleeding or anything. I'm on the side of the road and the other car's still there, but he's yelling at me.

I've passed this to a person, and a team member is joining the chat now.

Please call 000 now. Your neck and back are hurting and the other driver is yelling at you. If you can, stay in your car with the doors locked, or move somewhere away from him.

The claim can wait.
